component.name: Hibiki
component.summary: A high-fidelity keystroke and bubble visualizer for Wayland

description.p: Hibiki is a GTK4 Layer Shell keystroke visualizer built specifically for Wayland compositors. It shows what you type in a clean, modern overlay, which is perfect for screencasts, presentations, or pairing with mechanical-keyboard sounds.

ul.li: Two display modes: classic keystroke bubbles and a minimal bubble style
Optional unify-words grouping and repeated-key handling
Built-in Mechvibes-compatible audio engine and sound packs
Customizable typography, colors, and the Super-key icon
System tray, CLI control, and global hotkeys
